title: Docs-only direction update
purpose: Update Samantha direction, architecture, research, or reference markdown without touching executable code.
useWhen: The task changes markdown documentation only.
The work records product direction, architecture notes, research conclusions, playbooks, or reviewed lessons.
No source code, tests, generated run evidence, worktrees, or package configuration should change.
A cheap deterministic markdown-surface check is enough evidence for the task.

task.title: Update <docs-topic> documentation
task.instructions: Update only markdown documentation needed for this task. Keep the change surgical and direction-focused. Use cheap deterministic verification tied to the markdown diff; do not add broad code checks unless the task explicitly needs them. Treat references/playbooks/verification-duplication.md vocabulary as advisory planning only: harness verifyCommands remain the acceptance gate, and WORKER_VERIFY_EVIDENCE may disclose worker self-checks or skipped broad checks but cannot waive declared verification. Do not change source code, tests, package configuration, run logs, worktrees, task specs, task templates, agent profiles, hidden memory, or unscoped authority surfaces outside the declared target files.
